body.x: Inbody (www.inbody.com), the global leader in the body composition analysis industry with world-class technological advancement, introduced "Inbody Band" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Inbody Band is a wearable device equipped with a body composition analysis sensor. Made from a professional medical device manufacturer, InBody not only tracks and records daily activities, but analyzes the data to provide more complex information such as percantage of body fat, muscle mass, and such.
